privacy.title: Privacy notice
privacy.draft: Prototype draft. To be reviewed by the city's Data Protection Officer.
privacy.collectBody: Only your barangay. If you want text alerts, also your mobile number. If you send a report: its photos, the place you pinned and your note. We don't need your name, address or ID.
privacy.whyBody: To show your barangay's schedule and text you before the truck arrives.
privacy.whoBody: Only the City ENRO, to send reminders and act on reports. The truck crew sent to a report sees its photos and place. It is never sold or shared.
privacy.rightsBody: You can stop texts anytime (reply STOP) and delete your data in Settings. Reports you sent stay with the City as records, no longer linked to your phone. This follows the Data Privacy Act of 2012 (RA 10173).

a.greeting: Hello! I'm Kolek. Ask me when the collection is, where the truck is, how to report a problem, or how to sort your garbage.
a.thanks: You're welcome! I'm here if you have more questions.
a.needBarangay: To answer this, please choose your barangay first.
a.noSchedule: I couldn't find an upcoming collection for {{barangay}}.
a.reportSteps: Tap "Report", choose the problem, take a photo, and point to the spot on the map. You get a ticket number to follow it.
a.reportTargetNextDay: Response target: the next working day.
a.reportTargetBooked: The City ENRO will text you a pickup schedule.
a.emergencyCall: If there is a fire, someone is hurt or there is danger now, call {{hotline}} right away.
a.emergencyReport: For dangerous waste, report it and choose "Emergency".
a.emergencyReportCategory: Report it as "{{category}}" so it is handled first.
a.missedNoCollection: There is no collection in {{barangay}} today, so no truck was due.
a.missedHow: I'll check the truck's GPS for your street. Tap "Check my street".

sortHow.biodegradable: Keep it in a separate container or compost it. Don't mix it with plastic.
sortHow.recyclable: Clean and dry it, then set it aside for recycling or a junk shop.
sortHow.residual: Put it in a tied bag. This is what the truck takes for disposal.
sortHow.special: Don't mix it with other waste. Keep it safe and ask your barangay where to bring it.

a.sortSource: Based on {{law}}. Follow your barangay's rules too.
a.stats: This week, about {{tonnes}} tonnes were collected in {{trips}} trips, and {{served}} of streets were served.
a.sampleNote: This is sample data, not official city figures yet.

a.smsHow: Turn on text alerts: you'll get a text about {{minutes}} minutes before the truck arrives, and the evening before collection.

sus.intro: For the facilitator. After a participant has tried the app, have them rate the 10 statements. Use a code such as P1, never a name.
sus.incomplete: Answer all 10 statements and enter the code.
sus.few: Too few participants so far: the plan calls for 5 to 8.
